payload.leagueSummary: NET is a knife fight right now, with KeithK75, CRANK, and MattF setting the pace while the rest of the pack spends a lot of time donating shots to the golf gods. The best profiles in this window are not all built the same: KeithK75 and Dan94 can absolutely beat you with ball-striking, MattF is a full-bag menace, and CRANK keeps sneaking wins despite a gross game that looks like it was assembled in the dark. Lower down, the window is littered with guys whose tee-to-green math keeps leaking shots faster than the putter can plug the holes.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 is the cleanest all-around murderer in the file: elite ball-striking, almost no 3-putt nonsense, and the kind of gross profile that keeps showing up at the top like a bill you can’t dodge.
CRANK is the weirdest winner in here — the tee game is a mess, but the short game keeps drag-racing him back into contention. Ugly route, effective destination.

BigTime and DREADFUL are your cautionary tales. One can hit enough iron shots to matter but puts like he owes the cup money; the other is just bleeding strokes in every direction like a busted garden hose.
